landing.metadataDescription: Build a structured role manual for hiring, onboarding, and team review.
landing.heroTitle: Turn role context into a structured operating manual
landing.heroSubtitle: Collect role context, request a 26-block Role Guide, and review an editable draft for hiring and onboarding.
landing.methodologyTitle: Built from operating systems used by serious teams
landing.methodologySubtitle: Each source maps to concrete sections of the Role Guide, so the output explains purpose, autonomy, routines, quality bars, and collaboration boundaries.

netflix.title: Netflix Context over Control
netflix.description: Gives the role strategic context, clear boundaries, and room to act without micromanagement.

amazon.title: Amazon Leadership Principles
amazon.description: Turns culture into decision rules, input metrics, counter-metrics, and customer-oriented judgment.

toyota.title: Toyota Standardized Work
toyota.description: Captures the best-known way of working through checklists, exceptions, and quality criteria.

spotify.title: Spotify Squad Model
spotify.description: Shows how the role fits into real work streams, dependencies, squads, and growth paths.

bridgewater.title: Bridgewater Baseball Cards
bridgewater.description: Documents strengths, communication style, energy patterns, risks, and candidate fit.

landing.demoTitle: Annotated B2B sales Role Guide preview
landing.demoSubtitle: Explore a compact preview inspired by the sample B2B sales manager playbook. Each annotation explains why that block matters.

mission.title: Mission and key results
mission.excerpt: The role turns B2B pipeline into predictable revenue: it qualifies opportunities, moves deals forward, and keeps the funnel healthy.
mission.annotation: Mission connects the role purpose to measurable outcomes and gives managers a fast quality check.

decisions.title: Decision matrix
decisions.excerpt: Small discounts can move quickly; larger discounts and unusual contract terms require commercial approval.
decisions.annotation: Decision rules turn autonomy into visible guardrails, using the Amazon one-way/two-way door pattern.

kpi.title: KPI and counter-metrics
kpi.excerpt: Qualified pipeline, win rate, sales cycle, and first-year retention are paired to prevent metric gaming.
kpi.annotation: Counter-metrics keep the role from optimizing one number while damaging the business outcome.

landing.valueTitle: A structured guide built from real role context

0.title: Executive-ready output
0.description: The result is a practical operating manual, not a thin job post or lightweight outline.

1.title: Training-ready context
1.description: Competencies, tools, and workflows are captured clearly enough for managers and enablement teams to review.

2.title: Editable after generation
2.description: Teams can review and refine individual blocks without restarting the whole role discovery flow.

0.question: Who should use this first?
0.answer: HR leaders, founders, department heads, and enablement teams that need role clarity before hiring, onboarding, or training.

1.question: Can the generated guide be refined?
1.answer: Yes. The current version supports block-level review and refinement, so a team can tighten specific sections without restarting discovery.

2.question: What should I prepare before starting?
2.answer: A job description, role notes, team context, or a rough list of responsibilities is enough. The constructor asks follow-up questions where context is thin.

landing.finalCtaTitle: Build the first Role Guide for your team
landing.finalCtaDescription: Start with the constructor, answer the role questions, and keep the resulting draft useful as the team learns.
